DECISION: the cherries appear on three tiles: the website touch icon (the current file: the sticker on a black square, 180px), the iOS App Store icon (downloads/check-cherry/src3/app-icon-1024.png: the sticker on a Cherry Red rounded tile, rendered by Apple with the iOS glass effect that frosts the sticker) and the Android icon (this file: flat white C-cherries on a Cherry Red square, 512px). Chose the Android icon: it is the app icon (rule 1), in the brand's primary colour, flat and crisp, with no added background. Keep the current file if the reviewer prefers the website's black sticker tile.
